notes: Training task status has documented terminal states and a scalar taskId detail input.
IDE and inference service detail schemas provide only example status values, not complete state enums; no readiness or failure states are invented.
Model version export returns a JSON download URL rather than binary response content.
WAITING remains pending for running/completed waits because stopped tasks can be started again; this avoids failing before a start request becomes visible in the detail response.

endpoint_notes: Self-operated customer APIs under the explicitly listed v2 and v3 aipaas prefixes. The endpoint table is empty, while 52 captured request examples name ctxuntui-global.ctapi.ctyun.cn; that published production host supplies the endpoint.
request_notes: Terminal URI wildcards are bound to the single named path parameter documented per operation. EOP authorization, timestamp and request ID are generated by the core signer; the published ctyum-eop-request-id spelling is a documentation typo.
GET-based training start/stop, IDE start and storage delegation authorization are state-changing: confirmation is required and retries are disabled.
Nested structured inputs retain the published request schema in upstream evidence.

Dataset tags are described with the nonstandard String of Array(String) type but captured bodies contain arrays of key/value objects, which are preserved. Optional query list fields with that same type have no encoded URL examples; they accept an explicit serialized string without inventing CSV or repeated-key serialization.

API 22568 publishes optional string pageNum/pageSize in the query and required integer fields of the same names in a GET JSON body. Both locations are retained with distinct query-page-num/query-page-size options; the published body remains required.
response_notes: Most operations document or demonstrate statusCode 200 for success; image list API 22632 instead publishes statusCode 0 with populated results and is kept operation-specific. Error strings such as AIP_40000000 appear even in successful examples and are not standalone failure indicators.
